content: Absalón, Davidʼgi aibited
We-ibmar-gusad-sorba, Absalón bila-onoged-ur-napaginmalad amisad, molimar amisbalid, degine, sordamar-egi-nakulemalad e-dulabo-gakambe (50) amisbalid.

Absalón wakudaryala gwisguardaed, degine, neggwebur-yawagak-dogedgi signaddaed. Agine, dule-gwensak Rey-Davidʼse igar-nudakega nadapile, Absalón ese gotedaed, ega weyob sogdedaed: “¿Be biti-neggweburginedi?” Dule-nadapid abin-sogdedaed: “Dummad, an Israel-dule, an igar-nudaknadapi.”
Agine, Absalón ega sogdedabalid: “Nabir be igar-sedanikinad, deyob imaklegewilubbindo. Degi-inigwele, rey-asabin bega dule-ibmar-imaked satesunnad.”
Absalón ega sogdedabalid: “¡Ani an we-neggweburgi igar-nabogega-maina, bela-dule-anse-atakdanimaladga sogedba an ega igar-nudakoenad!”
Agine, dule-gwensak Absalón-asabin dulluu napase imakardibe, Absalón a-dule ogwisgusdaed, angaagwar gasdaed, geb e-ibe wagar-usdabalid.
Weyob Absalón bela Israel-dulemar reyse-igar-itogega-atakdanidamalad imakardaed. Deyob, Absalón dulemar-e-binsaed ganaidaed. Degisoggu, e-bina yaisur-itoge guarmalad.
Birgabakegusgua, Absalón, Rey-Davidʼga sokalid: —Dummad, wis an bese egise, Hebrón-neggweburse an nabienad, Bab-Jehováʼga an ibmar-imakoye-sogsad imaknaegar.
An Siria-yargi gudigua, Gesur-neggweburgi weyob an sogsa gusad: ‘Bab-Jehová Jerusalén-neggweburse gannar an-senonidibe, an Bab-Jehová-nug-odummodii guoye.’
Rey ega sogded: —Boni-sate, be nae. Agi Absalón Hebrón-neggweburse nade gusad.

Degidgine, Absalón, Israel-wagan-ambe-gakabo-bukwad-irba (12) dule-garda-berbemalad barmisad. Weyob sogsad: ‘Bemar gar-trompeta-gote-itodele, binnasur gotemalo: ¡Absalón Hebrón-neggweburgi negsemaiye!’
Absalón Jerusalén-neggweburgi dulemar dulataled-ilabo (200) sesad. Amar baisur-binsae eba-nade gusmalad, ibmar-wissuli eba-nade gusmalad.

Deginbali, Absalón Bab-Jehováʼga ibmar-ogumakar-uknaigua, Gilo-neggweburse Ahitofel-sunamalaga emar-barmisbalid. Ahitofelʼde, Davidʼga binsaed-daked-duled, Gilo-neggweburginedid. Deyob, rey-egwallegedgi-sunmakleged gangumai gualid, degine, dulemar Absalónʼba-nanaimalad mergumai guarbalid.
Garda-berbeged-gwensak Davidʼga sogdapid: “Belagwable Israel-dulemar Absalónʼba nagudmalad.”

Geb David e-sordamar-Jerusalén-neggweburgi-gudimaladga sogded: —Anmar gwae nae, anmar wakinnergebed. Ar degisulile, anmar Absalónʼgi wakinnosulid. Ar anmar bargalesale, Absalónʼse anmar ibitogoed, es-suidgi bela dulemar-ese-ibitomaloed.
Rey-David-sordamar rey-abin sogdemalad: —Rey-David, be anmar-dummadid. Anmar guakwagwad, be-sogedba anmar imako.
Degi, geb rey node gusad, bela e-sordamar eba nadmarmogad. Rey-e-omegan-dikarbalid-warambegwaddina (10) sorba neg-akwega obelesad.
Deyob Rey-David, bela e-sordaganmala nade gusad. Bannaba ambikudapmalad.
Bela rey-e-sordamar rey-dikarba ambikusmaladi wemalad:
Agine, Rey-David, Gat-dule-Itaiʼga sogded: —¿Ibiga be anmarba danimoga? Gannar Rey-Absalónʼse be nae, ar be dule-ainebalidid. Ar be-neggweburgi be onoles gudimogad.

¿Ar be emiskwaa nonigudisursi? ¿Sunna anba dagega an be-imakosi? Suli. Anbela an wissulid, an bia naoe. Bur be gannar nae, be-dulemar be sede. ¡Bab-Jehová-e-sabgued-sadeguad, degine, innikigwad-sogmaid bega oyogoed!
Itai, rey-abin sogded: —Ar Bab-Jehová-Dula-Maid-nuggi, degi, be an-dummad-gumogad-nuggine, an ise-sogar soged: Ar bia be naoe, an beba nai. An burgodibe, an burgosurdibe, akarsuli, an beba nai.
Geb David, Itaiʼga sogded: —Nabirdo. Anmarba be dagsunna. Gat-dule-Itai, degi, e-sordaganmala Rey-Davidʼba nade gusmalad, bela e-gwenadganmarse-bakar, nade gusmalad.
David e-sordaganmala-nadapmargua, bela dulemar ega ogormakdemalad. Rey-David e-sordaganmala Cedrón-diwar-maidgi obaksamalad. Geb degine, neg-dulesulidganba nade gusmalad.

We-dulemarba Sadoc nade gusmogad, degi, Levita-dulemar nade gusmarmogad. Amardina, Bab-Jehová-Dadganbo-Igar-Mesisad-Ulu semai gusmalad. We-dulemar, Bab-Jehová-Ulu napagi sisad. Degine geb, Abiatar, bela dulemar-neggweburgi-noed-obelosadse Bab-Dummadga ibmar-ogumakar uknai gualid.

Geb Rey-David, Sadocʼga sogded: —Bab-Jehová-Dadganbo-Igar-Mesisad-Ulu gannar Jerusalén-neggweburse be berbenao. Bab-Jehová nabir angi binsabidibe, gannar Jerusalén-neggweburse-dagega an-imakoed. Degi, gannar Bab-Jehová-Ulu-dakega an-imakbaloed. Deginbali, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-sunna-seleged-dakbaliga an-imakbaloed.
Ar Bab-Jehová sogdibe: ‘Bar an bebina sogsurye, ¿igi an bar saosunna? Bab-Jehová e-sogedba an-imakodo.’

Aginbali, Rey-David, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-Sadocʼga sogdebalid: —Ar be dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goledsoggu, nuedgi gannar be Abiatarʼbogwa Jerusalén-neggweburse nao. Degine, be-machi-Ahimaas, degi, Abiatar-machi-Jonatán, beba namarmogo.
Neba-naidgi dule-buksulidgi anmar ambikudapoed. Gardamar be anmarga-senonikidse anmar ambikuoed.
Degisoggu, Sadoc, Abiatarʼbogwa Bab-Jehová-Dadganbo-Igar-Mesisad-Ulu Jerusalén-neggweburse sesgusmalad, geb agine gudigusmalad.
Davidʼdina Olivo-yar-enaknai gualid, emurkwaa-bonadapi gusad, degi, sapat-sate nadapi gusbalid. Bela Davidʼba-nadapmalad, emurkwaa-bonadapi gusmarmogad.
Agine, Davidʼga sognonimalad: “Ahitofel, emargi-aibinega Absalónʼba gunaimoye.” Geb David weyob sogded: “¡Bab-Jehováʼye, Ahitofel-binsaed-ukedi be obure!”
David yar-birse, Bab-Dummadse-gorledaedse mosgua, Arquita-dule-Husai abingualid. We-dule, mor siir-siir David-abin danikid, geb e-nono olli-sichi danibalid.
David, Husaiʼga sogded: —Anba be dagye-sogele, binsa be anga arbaed onogoed.

Gannar be Jerusalénʼse-naed bur nabirid, adi, be Absalónʼga sogdapiga: ‘Rey, an be-maiga guoye. Igi an be-bab-Davidʼga arbadii gusa, deyob an bega arbadii gumogoye.’ Deyob be imaksale, sunna be Ahitofel-binsaed-ukedi obured.
Agi dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-Sadoc, degi, Abiatar, be-yarba gwichi gumaloed. Degisoggu, bela be rey-neguyagi-ibmar-itodagoedi, Sadocʼga, degi, Abiatarʼga be ogwaoed.
Degine, bela be-ibmar-itogoedi, Sadoc, e-machi-Ahimaasʼga ogwamogoed, degi, Abiatar, e-machi-Jonatánʼga ogwamogoed. A-sapingana, anga ibmar-ogwanai gumarmogoed.
Degidgine, David-e-ai-Husai, Jerusalén-neggweburse naded. Absalón neggweburse-dognadapidgine, Husai dognadapi gusmogad.
